ui_bugs.issue: Fixed by testing agent: 'Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused' — html5-qrcode Html5Qrcode.stop() throws synchronously when scanner state != SCANNING (e.g. after scanFile or on unmount with a never-started camera). Wrapped stop() calls with getState()===2 check + try/catch to prevent React error boundary triggering the CRA red overlay in dev.

critical_code_review_comments: QrScannerDialog: html5-qrcode's stop() has state-dependent throw behaviour (synchronous throw when NOT_STARTED). Using magic number 2 for SCANNING state is fragile; prefer Html5QrcodeScannerState.SCANNING import.
CouponQrDialog.download uses canvas.toBlob without a mimetype and relies on the returned blob's default; explicit 'image/png' + quality is safer for consistency.
PartnerDashboard shows a soft-warning preview ('Cupom não encontrado para este parceiro') even when input is < 4 chars would be cleaner UX, but current gating on length>=4 already handles that.
Backend /api/redemptions rejects idempotency_key duplicates via find_one and DuplicateKeyError — good; ensure a unique index exists on idempotency_key (not verified in this iteration).

rca of the issue: Bug: React error overlay 'Cannot stop, scanner is not running or paused' when using scanner file-upload fallback. Repro: open Partner dashboard > click open-scanner-button > (camera never started, e.g. no camera or NotFoundError) > upload a QR image. Root cause: QrScannerDialog.scanFile called await scannerRef.current.stop() unconditionally; html5-qrcode throws synchronously from stop() when internal state is NOT_STARTED, bypassing the .catch on the promise chain in cleanup. Fix: only call stop() when getState()===SCANNING(2) and wrap in try/catch; also hardened dialog unmount cleanup similarly.
